item.title: Bulletin updated at 17:35 HKT 23/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over southern China this week. It will be windy over the coastal areas in the next couple of days. Besides, an area of low pressure will develop gradually over the seas east of the Philippines in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 24/10 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Sunny periods. One or two showers at first.
Temp range: 23 - 28 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
